en: Complex Challenges (CCs) are very similar to regular Challenges, but have a few key differences:
zh: 复数挑战（CC）与普通挑战非常相似，但有几个关键区别：

en: Complex Challenges require x

en: to complete, and take place within a Complex.
zh: 才能完成，并且发生在复数层级内。

en: A Complex Challenge must be unlocked with UP before you can enter it.
zh: 复数挑战必须先使用 UP 解锁，然后你才能进入它。

en: Each Complex Challenge can be completed up to 5 times. The reward and goal increase for each completion.
zh: 每个复数挑战最多可完成 5 次。每次完成都会提高奖励和目标。

en: Each unique Complex Challenge completion is called a Complex Challenge tier, usually shortened to "CC tier".
zh: 每一个不同的复数挑战完成称为一个复数挑战层级，通常简称为「CC 层级」。

en: You can only have one Complex Challenge unlocked at a time.
zh: 你一次只能解锁一个复数挑战。

en: By unlocking Complex Challenges, you have also unlocked new Milestones. Read the "Milestones" section for more information.
zh: 通过解锁复数挑战，你也解锁了新的里程碑。阅读「里程碑」部分以了解更多信息。

en: Once you have completed 20 CC tiers, you will unlock 5 additional Complex Challenges, so there is a total of 50 completable CC tiers.
zh: 一旦你完成 20 个 CC 层级，你将解锁 5 个额外的复数挑战，因此总共有 50 个可完成的 CC 层级。

zh: 在复数挑战 7 中，停留在复数挑战子标签页可能会导致显示卡死。

en: However, you can usually still navigate to other tabs.
zh: 不过，你通常仍然可以切换到其他标签页。
